title: freesia brevis
intro: Freesia brevis, commonly known as African cat's eye, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Freesia brevis include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Freesia brevis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its fragrance and therapeutic actions.
